chapter_title: [Concer]ning why, if the Person shall look down in
spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation: On the Inversion of Spiritual Realities in Natural Truth

---

**¶1:** When the understanding stands above natural truth and directs its perception downward into that truth, if it beholds its own interior quality reflected there, why does it find that what is highest in wisdom has become lowest, and what is lowest and most external has been raised to the uppermost place? And yet, when the understanding gazes fixedly into natural truth, its own essential character is not made manifest, nor can it perceive itself there directly.

---

**¶3:** [GAP-1] This also: The interior quality of human understanding and the forms of perception appear inverted in natural truth, and this is what is signified in [GAP-2] the hidden law of the divine call — when divine truth was sent down into the realms of falsity toward the primordial celestial human. Sin[GAP-3: ce divine truth descended,] in this manner it cast itself downward [GAP-4: into the lowest states of the natural mind] like a person [GAP-5] who plunges headlong into natural truth; so it is also with the divine call. It cast itself with its inmost things foremost into the realms below, with power and urgency.

---

**¶4:** And this too: Should the understanding lift itself up out of natural truth, its interior quality is not visible to it in what lies below, being turned away from the natural plane. This expresses the hidden law of the will's responsive ascent, which rose from the lowest states — from the primordial celestial human, its origin — upward toward the Divine Life itself.

---

**¶5:** The interior qualities of understanding, of affection, and of perception are all visible in natural truth, suspended in inversion. This corresponds to the hidden law of interior spiritual knowledges and the celestial orders of influx, which hang inverted and are made visible in the vast aggregate of natural truths. For the interior qualities of understanding, of affection, and of all perceptions depend upon the origin-point of those spiritual knowledges and celestial orders, being begotten from them. Just as their spiritual origins, which are spread out in the higher realm, are themselves inverted in their descent — so it is that the hidden reality of those origins is revealed to their derivatives whenever the understanding directs itself downward into natural truth. This is the reason their forms are found in an inverted state.

---

**¶6:** Not only this, but [GAP-6] every new spiritual state that comes into being — as the appointed moment approaches for it to enter the natural plane — it hangs inverted and is born with what is highest entering first into the lowest. Indeed, because of this law, its hidden spiritual nature is revealed in those natural truths into which the understanding gazes.

---

**¶7:** Behold, you will find that the natural correspondence of a person who progresses through life is joined to the corporeal plane at all times. If the person is disturbed [GAP-7: and seeks to separate] his natural correspondence upward from the corporeal plane [GAP-8: he finds it bound] above. It is impossible for him to [GAP-9: sever that bond while he remains] in the corporeal plane. See, this hidden reality is [GAP-10] a profound sign, signifying that the entire external form originated from the corporeal plane and had been elevated from the deepest natural states. Again, because of this, its natural correspondence remains joined to the corporeal plane, tending always downward, yet suspended from the spiritual above.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: When the person is above water and looking down [into the wat]ers, if he shall see his face reflected why shall you find his head turned upside down and also his feet upwards? Yet, when he stares down into the waters, his face shall not be visible, nor can he see it there?

[And] this: The face of people and the shape of trees shall appear turned upside down in the water as this is signified in [the] mystery of the summons, when it was sent down to the worlds of Darkness towards the First Man. Sin[ce the summons came down] in this way it cast itself down [to the depths] like a person [who] plunges headlong into water; so it is also with the summons. It cast itself headlong to the worlds below, with strength and diligence.

And this too: Shall the person lift his head up from the water, his face shall not be visible to him, being bent below. This characterises the mystery of the obedience that ascended from below, from with the First Man his father to the Living Spirit.

The face of people and of animals and of trees is visible in the water, hanging upside down. This occurs to the mystery of the stars and the zodiac, which hang upside down and are visible in the great sea. For the face of people and beasts and all trees hang on the root of the stars and the zodiac, being begotten from them. Just as their fathers, who are spread out above, hang upside down; so it is also that the mystery of their fathers is being revealed to them whenever they stare down into the water. This is, that you shall find their shapes inverted.

Not only this, but [the] child who is born; as the ho[ur] approaches for him to be born, he hangs upside down and is born head first. Indeed, due to this, his mystery shall be revealed in these waters people stare down into.

Behold, you will find the shadow of the person who walks along is joined to the earth all the time. If the person is troubled [and seeks to lift] his shadow up upon the earth [it is bound from] above. It is impossible for him to do [this, to part from his shadow while he remains] on the earth. See, this mystery is [a] great sign, signifying that the entire body came from the earth and had ascended from the abyss. Again, due to this, its shadow is joined on the earth, turned downwards, and hanging from above.

fills.explanation: The conjunction "And" is standard Kephalaia transitional language introducing a new explanatory passage that elaborates on the preceding teaching; the spiritual reading confirms this connective function.

The definite article "the" is required before "mystery of the summons," referring to a specific, known cosmological event — the divine call sent to the First Man — as confirmed by the spiritual reading's reference to "the hidden law of the divine call."

The spiritual reading specifies "since divine truth descended" — in the Kephalaia's natural register, "divine truth" sent toward the First Man is "the summons," which was just named in the preceding clause, and "came down" matches the descent language of the passage.

The spiritual reading says "into the lowest states of the natural mind"; in the Kephalaia's cosmological vocabulary this is "the depths," consistent with the passage's language of "worlds of Darkness" and "worlds below" and the later reference to "the abyss" in ¶7.
The relative pronoun "who" is grammatically required to introduce the relative clause "plunges headlong into water," modifying "a person," and the spiritual reading confirms this construction.

The definite article "the" before "child who is born" functions as a generic reference to any child — standard Kephalaia usage for expressing a universal type through a particular image — matching the spiritual reading's "every new spiritual state."

The spiritual reading specifies "and seeks to separate" the correspondence upward; in the natural-plane vocabulary of shadows, lifting is the physical action corresponding to separation, and "lift...up" forms a natural collocation with the "up" that immediately follows in the visible text.

The spiritual reading says "he finds it bound above"; in the Kephalaia's register, the shadow's inability to be lifted is expressed as being bound, and "from above" completes the phrase with the visible "above" that follows, matching the paragraph's conclusion that the shadow is "hanging from above."

The indefinite article "a" before "great sign" is grammatically required and confirmed by the spiritual reading's "a profound sign."
